notes.title: Started distributing “fan kits” for live game distribution!
notes.content:
Thank you for always supporting ''Kemono Teatime''.
We have prepared a "Fan Kit" that can be used for game streaming.
Please use the kit (logos, characters, backgrounds, etc) to make your game streaming much cuter ✨.

*Please refrain from secondary distribution, commercial use and unauthorized reproduction.

notes.title: Demo版アップデートのお知らせ
notes.content:
[Adjustments]
Added a page for operation instructions to the "CONFIG" menu.
Fixed a bug where pressing the F key while typing text would activate the "Hide Cursor" feature.
Adjusted rendering processes to fix display issues occurring in certain environments.
Fixed other minor bugs.

We greatly appreciate your continued support for "Kemono Teatime."
